description: Change an existing folder's name, description or parent; only the fields you pass change. To add a folder use driftnet_create_folder, to remove one driftnet_delete_folder, and to move cards between folders driftnet_move_items. The id stays the same after a rename, so ids you hold keep working. description replaces the classifier rule for future links; items already inside are not re-sorted. parent moves the folder with everything inside it: another folder id, or null for the top level; omit it to leave the folder where it is. It can't be moved into itself or its own sub-folders. Fails if the folder does not exist or the change is refused (empty name, a loop, a name clash).

description.description: New rule for what belongs here, up to 300 chars

parent.description: New parent folder id; null for the top level; omit to keep it

name: driftnet_update_folder
title: Rename, re-describe or move a folder
